targets.Description: Huw Irranca-Davies stood as Labour party candidate for Ogmore at the 2016 National Assembly for Wales election and was elected to serve as AM. In 2001, Irranca-Davies was Labour candidate for the Brecon & Radnor constituency, but finished third. In the by-election of 2002 he was elected to the parliamentary seat of Ogmore. He was re-elected to serve Ogmore in the general elections of 2005, 2010 and 2015.

targets.Description: The Margaret Thatcher Foundation was formed in 1991 to advance the cause of political and economic freedom. The Foundation has five broad goals:promotion the acceptance of democracy, market principles, the rule of law, and strong defence; encouraging strong transatlantic links between Britain, Europe, and North America; assisting and encouraging the peoples of the former communist countries and other oppressive regimes across the world as they adopt democracy; fostering greater contact between Western nations and those of the Middle East and supporting free trade throughout the world.
